claim: An unmeasured model call is refused rather than counted as zero, and the recorded per-call parts must reconcile exactly with the provider's own reported total.

steps.label: a call whose usage the provider reported
a call that genuinely consumed nothing
steps.note: Zero is a measurement. It is recorded, and it is not the same thing as the next step.

steps.label: a call whose usage never arrived
steps.note: Treating unknown as zero is how a budget drifts away from reality while every number in it stays defensible.

steps.label: the same call recorded twice
steps.note: The other direction a total can drift.

steps.label: the provider bills for a call this account never saw
steps.evidence: sum of the parts must equal the whole
steps.note: A single running counter cannot detect this. A per-call ledger can.
